topic: 科学与口语深入讨论 · Independent new scenario: trade-offs in managing shared resources
grammarFocus: 间接问句；名词性从句；比较、原因和假设表达综合。 Teach the new rule in Chinese, then provide at least 8 distinct grammar questions in new sentences. Distinguish a newly taught form from revision. All main reading/listening question prompts and options must be English, with short A0/A1 English prompts. Chinese explanations are allowed. Preserve a coherent new scenario; do not rename an earlier text, reuse its facts or reveal answers in question stems.
sourcePolicy: Project-original scenario; simulated figures and people; no copied official test, textbook, GitHub PDF or third-party audio.
title: The Community Garden Water Ration
instructions: 本材料为原创模拟练习，非官方雅思试题，也不对应任何官方分数。请先听/读对话，完成10道听力题；再学习语法规则并完成8道语法题；最后进行口语和写作迁移练习。所有题目答案均来自材料原文，注意间接问句、名词性从句及比较/原因/假设表达。
transcript:
Maya: Hi, Tom. You look worried. What's the problem?
Tom: It's the community garden. The water bill doubled this month. We need to decide how we should share the water.
Maya: I see. Do you know why the bill increased so much?
Tom: The hot weather, I think. Also, some people leave the tap running. I'm not sure who does it.
Maya: We could ask everyone to use less water. But what if the vegetables dry out?
Tom: That's the trade-off. If we cut water by half, some plants may die. If we don't cut it, we can't pay the bill.
Maya: Have you asked the other gardeners what they think?
Tom: Yes, I spoke to three of them. They said they would accept a schedule. One person asked whether we could collect rainwater.
Maya: That's a good idea. Do you know how much rain we get here?
Tom: Not much in summer, but we can try. The problem is the cost of the barrels.
Maya: Could we ask the city for help? I wonder if they have a program.
Tom: Maybe. But I don't know when they would reply. We need a decision this week.
Maya: Let's compare the options. Option A: everyone waters only on Monday and Thursday. Option B: each person gets a fixed amount per week.
Tom: Option B sounds fairer, but it's harder to check. Option A is simpler, but some people might forget.
Maya: What if we try Option A for one month and see if the bill goes down?
Tom: That's a good compromise. But we must explain clearly why we are doing it.
Maya: I can write a notice. I'll ask people to tell me if they have problems with the schedule.
Tom: Thanks, Maya. Could you also ask whether anyone has extra barrels?
Maya: Sure. I'll do that today.

questions.prompt: What is the main problem in the conversation?
options: The water bill doubled.
The garden has too many plants.
Tom lost his keys.
questions.explanation: Tom明确说“The water bill doubled this month.”，所以主要问题是水费翻倍。
questions.evidence: The water bill doubled this month.

questions.prompt: Why does Tom think the bill increased?
options: Because of the hot weather and people leaving the tap running.
Because the city raised the water price.
Because Maya used too much water.
answers: Because of the hot weather and people leaving the tap running.
questions.explanation: Tom说“The hot weather, I think. Also, some people leave the tap running.”，因此原因是天气热和有人不关水龙头。
questions.evidence: The hot weather, I think. Also, some people leave the tap running.

questions.prompt: What did the other gardeners say about a schedule?
options: They would accept a schedule.
They refused any schedule.
They wanted to stop gardening.
questions.explanation: Tom说“They said they would accept a schedule.”，说明其他园丁愿意接受时间表。
questions.evidence: They said they would accept a schedule.

questions.prompt: What is the problem with collecting rainwater?
options: The cost of the barrels.
There is too much rain.
The city does not allow it.
questions.explanation: Tom说“The problem is the cost of the barrels.”，所以收集雨水的问题是桶的成本。
questions.evidence: The problem is the cost of the barrels.

questions.prompt: Which option does Tom think is fairer?
options: Option B: each person gets a fixed amount per week.
Option A: everyone waters only on Monday and Thursday.
Neither option is fair.
answers: Option B: each person gets a fixed amount per week.
questions.explanation: Tom说“Option B sounds fairer”，因此他认为B方案更公平。

questions.prompt: What is Maya's suggestion for a compromise?
options: Try Option A for one month and see if the bill goes down.
Stop watering the garden completely.
Ask the city to pay the whole bill.
answers: Try Option A for one month and see if the bill goes down.
questions.explanation: Maya说“What if we try Option A for one month and see if the bill goes down?”，这是她的折中建议。
questions.evidence: What if we try Option A for one month and see if the bill goes down?

options: Write a notice and ask about extra barrels.
Call the city office.
Buy new barrels for the garden.
answers: Write a notice and ask about extra barrels.
questions.explanation: Maya说“I can write a notice.”，Tom请她问“whether anyone has extra barrels”，Maya回答“Sure. I'll do that today.”，所以她今天会写通知并询问多余的桶。

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with ONE WORD from the conversation: Tom says that Option B sounds ______.
questions.explanation: 原文中Tom说“Option B sounds fairer”，因此填fairer。

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with ONE WORD from the conversation: Maya says she can write a ______.
questions.explanation: Maya说“I can write a notice.”，所以填notice。

questions.prompt: According to the conversation, has Tom asked the city for help?
options: Yes, he has already asked the city.
No, he has not asked the city; Maya suggests it and Tom says 'Maybe.'
The conversation does not say whether Tom has asked the city.
answers: No, he has not asked the city; Maya suggests it and Tom says 'Maybe.'
questions.explanation: Maya提出“Could we ask the city for help?”，Tom回答“Maybe. But I don't know when they would reply.”这说明Tom尚未向市政府求助，只是考虑这个建议。
questions.evidence: Maybe. But I don't know when they would reply.

grammar.title: 间接问句、名词性从句与比较/原因/假设表达综合
grammar.explanation: 本课重点：1) 间接问句：把直接问句变成宾语从句时，用陈述语序，不用助动词倒装。例如直接问“Why did the bill increase?”，间接问句是“Do you know why the bill increased?”。2) 名词性从句：从句可以作主语、宾语或表语，常用that, whether, what, who, why, how等引导。例如“I'm not sure who does it.”中who does it是宾语从句。3) 比较表达：fairer, harder, simpler等比较级用于比较两个方案。4) 原因表达：because, since, as, the reason is that等。5) 假设表达：if条件句和what if...?表示假设。注意：间接问句里不要用“do/does/did”倒装，也不要保留问号（除非主句是问句）。
grammar.example: Do you know why the bill increased so much?

options: Do you know where the meeting is?
Do you know where is the meeting?
Do you know where does the meeting?
answers: Do you know where the meeting is?
questions.explanation: 间接问句用陈述语序：where the meeting is，不用倒装。
questions.evidence: 间接问句规则：宾语从句用陈述语序。

options: I wonder if she will come.
I wonder if will she come.
I wonder if does she come.
answers: I wonder if she will come.
questions.explanation: if引导的间接问句用陈述语序：if she will come。
questions.evidence: if引导宾语从句时用陈述语序。

options: The reason is that we need to save water.
The reason is because we need to save water.
The reason is why we need to save water.
answers: The reason is that we need to save water.
questions.explanation: The reason is that...是标准原因表达；不用because或why。
questions.evidence: 原因表达：The reason is that...。

options: This plan is simpler than that one.
This plan is more simple than that one.
This plan is simplest than that one.
answers: This plan is simpler than that one.
questions.explanation: simple的比较级是simpler，不用more simple；than用于比较。

options: What if it rains tomorrow?
What if does it rain tomorrow?
What if it will rain tomorrow?
questions.explanation: What if...?后用一般现在时表示将来假设，不用will或does倒装。
questions.evidence: 假设表达：What if + 一般现在时。

options: I don't know when they will reply.
I don't know when will they reply.
I don't know when do they reply.
answers: I don't know when they will reply.
questions.explanation: when引导的宾语从句用陈述语序：when they will reply。
questions.evidence: 间接问句：when they will reply。

options: She asked whether we could collect rainwater.
She asked whether could we collect rainwater.
She asked whether we can collected rainwater.
answers: She asked whether we could collect rainwater.
questions.explanation: whether引导的间接问句用陈述语序，且时态一致：whether we could collect rainwater。
questions.evidence: 间接问句：whether we could collect rainwater。

options: If we cut water by half, some plants may die.
If we will cut water by half, some plants may die.
If we cut water by half, some plants may died.
answers: If we cut water by half, some plants may die.
questions.explanation: if条件句用一般现在时表将来，主句用may + 动词原形。
questions.evidence: 假设表达：If + 一般现在时, 主句用may + 动词原形。

part1: Do you often use shared resources like water or electricity?
What do you do when a shared resource is limited?
Have you ever had a disagreement about sharing something?
How do you usually solve problems with neighbors or friends?
speaking.part2: Describe a time when you had to share a limited resource with others. You should say: what the resource was; who you shared it with; what the problem was; and how you solved it.

What are the advantages and disadvantages of fixed limits?
How can a community make fair decisions about shared resources?
Do you think technology can help manage shared resources? How?
